pairs: In the second year of king Darius,
on the first day of the month,
factum est verbum Domini in manu Aggæi prophetæ,
the word of the Lord came, by the hand of Haggai the prophet,
to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel,
and to Jesus the son of Jehozadak,
Thus says the Lord of hosts, saying:
dicens: Populus iste dicit: Nondum venit tempus domus Domini ædificandæ.
This people claims that the time has not yet arrived for building the house of the Lord.
Et factum est verbum Domini in manu Aggæi prophetæ,
But the word of the Lord came by the hand of Haggai the prophet,
Numquid tempus vobis est ut habitetis in domibus laqueatis,
Is it time for you to dwell in paneled houses,
Et nunc hæc dicit Dominus exercituum:
And now, thus says the Lord of hosts:
Ponite corda vestra super vias vestras.
Set your hearts upon your ways.
has put them in a bag with holes.
Thus says the Lord of hosts:
Ponite corda vestra super vias vestras;
Set your hearts upon your ways.
and it shall be acceptable to me,
quam ob causam? dicit Dominus exercituum:
What is the cause of this, says the Lord of hosts?
It is because my house is desolate,
et vos festinatis unusquisque in domum suam.
yet you have hurried, each one to his own house.
Propter hoc super vos prohibiti sunt cæli ne darent rorem,
Because of this, the heavens over you have been prohibited from giving dew,
et terra prohibita est ne daret germen suum:
and the earth has been prohibited from giving her sprouts.
And I called a drought over the land,
and whatever the soil would bring forth,
and over all the labor of hands.
And Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel,
and Jesus the son of Jehozadak,
sacerdos magnus, et omnes reliquiæ populi, vocem Domini Dei sui,
and all the remnant of the people heeded the voice of the Lord their God,
and the words of Haggai the prophet,
sicut misit eum Dominus Deus eorum ad eos, et timuit populus a facie Domini.
just as the Lord their God sent him to them. And the people were fearful before the face of the Lord.
Et dixit Aggæus, nuntius Domini de nuntiis Domini,
And Haggai, a messenger of the Lord among messengers of the Lord,
Et suscitavit Dominus spiritum Zorobabel, filii Salathiel,
And the Lord stirred the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel,
and the spirit of Jesus the son of Jehozadak,
et spiritum reliquorum de omni populo:
and the spirit of the remainder of all the people.
et ingressi sunt, et faciebant opus in domo Domini exercituum, Dei sui.
And they entered and performed work in the house of the Lord of hosts their God.
